description: Auto-merge uses GitHub native auto-merge + squash (a real PR satisfying the main ruleset), NOT branch automerge — the ruleset requires a PR, so branch automerge would be blocked.

customManagers.description: Track self-hosted (vendored) front-end assets via static/vendor/versions.txt; a PR here is a heads-up to re-vendor the dist files.

Track the OSV-Scanner binary version pinned in the scheduled scan. Renovate bumps OSV_VERSION; update OSV_SHA256 to match (the workflow's sha256sum -c fails loudly until you do — the hosted Renovate App can't recompute a binary checksum).

packageRules.description: atheris is pinned per-interpreter by hand in pyproject.toml — its wheel coverage shifts per release (3.1.0 dropped the cp311 wheel), so an auto-bump re-breaks the Python 3.11 CI leg (see #464 / #466). Renovate must not touch it. Remove this rule once Python 3.11 is dropped from the support matrix.

js-yaml is pinned to v4 via an npm `overrides` entry in package.json — it is a transitive dep of markdownlint-cli2 (the dev-only `lint:md` tool), which does a default `import yaml from "js-yaml"`. js-yaml v5 is ESM-only and dropped the default export, so forcing v5 through the override breaks the required `lint` check (see #516). Cap Renovate below v5 until markdownlint-cli2 ships js-yaml v5 support; revisit then.
Vendored front-end assets require a manual dist re-vendor — never auto-merge; label for review.
Auto-merge patch + minor updates of dev/test tooling once CI passes (a failing check blocks the merge).
Roll non-major GitHub Actions version updates into one weekly PR (reviewed).
Auto-merge GitHub Actions digest re-pins (same version, new SHA) once CI passes.

Auto-merge base-image digest re-pins (same tag, new SHA) once CI passes. Keeps OS security patches flowing without waiting on a weekly manual merge: the runtime apt-upgrade layer is keyed on the FROM digest, so a digest bump is what busts the gha build cache and re-pulls Debian fixes (see PR #216, where a lagging bump let 15 OpenSSL CVEs accumulate). Digest-only — a uv/base version bump is a different updateType and is NOT auto-merged.

Auto-merge the python base-image PATCH bumps (e.g. 3.14.6 -> 3.14.7) once CI passes. The Dockerfile pins the explicit patch tag (`3.14.X-slim-trixie`) rather than the floating `3.14` tag, so a CPython bugfix release is a named, reviewable-in-history version PR instead of the opaque digest-only bump the floating tag produced — while still auto-flowing so CVE/bugfix patches don't accumulate (same intent as the digest rule above). A MINOR bump (3.15) is a real interpreter upgrade that the CI support matrix must move with, so it is left as a manual, reviewed PR.
Group security-tooling actions — same security.yml scanners, useful to review together.
Group release-automation actions (knope + amannn semantic PR title). Both feed the changeset -> knope release pipeline and tend to need joint review on majors.
